items.title: I Had Incredible Bosses. They Still Only Used 30% of Me.
items.pt:
I Had Incredible Bosses. They Still Only Used 30% of Me.


A quick note first. My last few posts have stepped away from the project write-ups. The crop rotation one was that. This one is too. A slice of life, not a ruling on how anyone should work.

The technical stuff is not gone. I have been in the middle of work I actually want to write up. Grading AI-written code properly. Putting AI inside a real business system instead of beside it. A couple of builds that are bigger than a feature ticket.

items.title: How I Prepared for and Cleared the Salesforce SMTS Interview
items.pt:

The loop heavily evaluated DSA, Low-Level Design (LLD), High-Level Design (HLD), and deep-dives into my past work experiences. Overall, the rounds were rigorous but collaborative, practical, and grounded in real-world problem-solving.

items.pt: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. items.pt: What makes great scientists great? items.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
items.pt: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments.
